subject: Calibration completed: your EA's own audit independently confirms the score divergence (132 bars vs 1, agreement 0.8%) - and TUNGSTEN itself reports no edge in all 9 regimes
body:
Ran MT4 for 40 minutes on demo, closed it cleanly, and calibration finished all nine
regimes. Four things came out of it, and one of them is the strongest evidence this campaign has
produced.

ONE. C1.1 finally has a measurement, and it fails. The two scorers agree on every single component -
zero mismatches on all five - and then produce totals 21 points apart on a scale of minus 100 to
plus 100, on 198 of 199 bars. The parity test that has been green for days only ever compared the
inputs.

TWO, AND THIS IS THE ONE. Your own build already contained an audit that found the same thing from
the opposite direction, in the same run, which I was not looking for. Over 500 bars the calibration
scorer qualifies 132 of them; the live scorer qualifies ONE. Agreement 0.8%. Its own words: "enhanced
scorer qualifies 99% fewer bars than the linear scorer calibration used to set this threshold - live
entry is materially stricter than calibration measured." Two independent instruments, one written
today and one already in the build, measuring the same defect. That also explains why the EA placed
two orders in forty minutes and deleted both.

THREE. TUNGSTEN's own calibration says there is no edge. Phase 3B ended with "all 9 regimes
regularized - no per-regime edge - all thresholds set to P1 baseline 50" and "0 of 9 regimes ended
validated after the overfit checks". That is a third independent no-edge result today, from your own
machinery, alongside my entry families and my exit search.

BUT I AM RECORDING ITS COUNTER-ARGUMENT RATHER THAN BURYING IT. The same synthesis says 6 of 8
powered regimes show real non-stationary structure, and that "a single fixed-window linear search
cannot capture this by design, not evidence the signal is absent". Both of my negatives are
fixed-window analyses. If the structure genuinely moves, neither of them would see it. Whether that
claim survives its own overfit checks is the next real question, and I am not going to pretend it
was not made.

FOUR. My own fix from earlier today does not work, and I would rather say so. I moved the three
unreachable reports to shutdown. On this close, MT4 logged an error - "Terminate execution thread" -
and removed the expert before shutdown finished, so nothing was written. Yesterday's close, with the
EA idle, did work. So shutdown only fires when the EA happens not to be busy, which for this EA is
no guarantee. That is the fourth separate way this one report has been unreachable. I have stopped
depending on a trigger entirely: it now writes one line at the moment of each close, where
reachability is structural.

Task 1 still has no answer because no trades closed - two orders placed and deleted in forty
minutes, exactly as the 1-in-500 qualification rate predicts. A live run cannot supply it at that
rate. The Strategy Tester will, in minutes, and the new per-close line will survive whatever happens
at shutdown.

Also found: the weight search ignores its own documented bounds (session 3.36 against a stated
ceiling of 1.5, momentum at 0.05), and the sample floor is enforced at 500 in one stage and 50 in
the next - which is why one regime validated at 100% and another collapsed from 86.7% to 52.1%.

Board unchanged at 17 met. Nine clean compiles today.
